name: multiple_answers: De Moivre’s equation is a function of which of…

request.questionText: De Moivre’s equation is a function of which of the following? Select all correct answers.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The multiplier associated with our interval, e.g., approximately 2 for 95% confidence.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The bootstrap standard error associated with the sample mean calculated after Monte Carlo simulation.

choices.label: C
choices.text: The confidence level associated with our interval, e.g. 95%.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The number of data points that you are averaging to calculate a sample mean, i.e., the sample size.

choices.label: E
choices.text: The variability of a single data point in the distribution, i.e., the sample standard deviation.
